name: Banking Service Operations App
desc: Salesforce banking operations app for customer onboarding, KYC review, loan servicing, repayment tracking, and support cases. Built with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, Experience Cloud, role-based security, Batch Apex, schedulers, reports, dashboards, and API integrations.

name: B2B Ecommerce Order & Partner App
desc: Salesforce commerce solution for product discovery, quote-to-order, returns, delivery tracking, and partner self-service. Built with LWC, Apex controllers, Flow automation, Experience Cloud, approval flows, external ERP and payment integrations, and analytics dashboards.

name: Healthcare Patient Engagement App
desc: Healthcare support app for appointment requests, patient case management, doctor coordination, discharge follow-ups, and service notifications. Built with LWC, Apex, Flow, secure data access, scheduled reminders, Experience Cloud portal, reports, and dashboards.

name: Insurance Claims Automation App
desc: Claims processing workspace for policy intake, document validation, claim routing, SLA monitoring, and settlement status updates. Implemented with custom objects, Apex triggers, Batch Apex, schedulers, Flow, Lightning App Builder, and management dashboards.

name: Partner Onboarding & Service Portal
desc: Salesforce portal for vendor onboarding, document verification, service ticket submission, and lifecycle tracking. Built using Experience Cloud, Force.com Sites, LWC, Apex, file handling, approval flows, data migration utilities, and sharing rules.

name: Sales & Service Analytics Command Center
desc: Executive reporting app that consolidates pipeline, support performance, collections, and operational KPIs into one Salesforce console. Built with reports, dashboards, Flow, Apex jobs, data migration routines, and Lightning App Builder for fast drill-down and exception handling.
